d: Al takes corrective action after getting to the bottom of the strange happenings in Linea's town. However, the primary reason why he agreed to visit is his interest in a locally grown vegetable.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills

d: Navigating his way across troubled waters, Al is in for a rude shock when he arrives at the castle to drop off the demon king's precious daughter.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
st: The Farmer and the New Resolution
d: After an unsettling encounter at the castle, Al cannot stop thinking about the connection between his tragic past and a mysterious evil force.
Hiraku won't waste his second chance at life and decides he will focus on what truly matters; he builds a new home with his own two hands.
As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku's loneliness grows; he thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.
Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive.
Now that they've secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.
With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation as winter is coming.
A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool; as word spreads, their home blooms into a village.
Hiraku realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.

st: The Researcher and the Two Princesses
d: They say civilization started because of alcohol; in the Great Tree Village's case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.
Hiraku's offhand comment leads to a series of events that end with a merchant setting up a trade deal with The Great Tree Village.
Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village.
News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren't the only ones interested.
Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning; as he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.

d: Allen, who has worked hard and built a good relationship with Cecil, is finally able to go out hunting demons.

d: Allen's uncanny ability to hunt monsters earns him a promotion, and the baron's family awaits a visit from the eldest son. Life is good. For now.

d: Allen rushes to town to help the knights and gatekeepers fight against a B-ranked magical beast. In the spring, Mihai arrives and challenges Allen to a rematch.

t: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World With Garbage Balancing
d: Zenov discovers the White Dragon's old area is now overrun with magical beasts. Allen resolves to hunt these creatures in the mountain range and nearby regions.

t: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World With Garbage Balancing
d: Allen locates Cecil, who fled the mansion after discovering her brother's death and the harsh reality of noble obligations. Allen proposes they escape town together after seeing Cecil so heartbroken.

t: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World With Garbage Balancing
d: Allen and Cecil have a long, dangerous road ahead of them as reaching safety means facing more than just one threat.
A chance encounter with a mysterious stranger introduces Ko to nocturnal life, leading him to explore the city at night.
Nazuma remains frustratingly elusive, but Ko may have a nostalgic solution to this new problem.
As Ko reconnects with a classmate, questions arise he isn't sure he knows how to answer.
Three's a crowd when Ko invites Akira to hang out with him and Nazuna late one evening.
Ko gets the inside scoop on Nazuna's business, but first he needs to make sense of his complicated emotions.
Ko doesn't need a mirror to see his reflection; it's staring right back at him in the form of Nazuna's latest client.
Boredom drives Ko into the night; boredom drives Ko's new acquaintance into killing time in her own way; she and Ko seem very similar, perhaps too similar for comfort.
Ko thinks he has all the time in the world, but the revelation of an unexpected deadline changes everything; hopefully his friends have some advice.
Seri is extremely popular, but popularity isn't all it's cracked up to be when one of her human paramours develops feelings she isn't ready to deal with.
It's not all sparkles and hearts at the maid café where Midori works; someone is creeping on a certain maid, but uncovering the interloper isn't as easy as it looks.

st: Do You Know What a Vampire Is?
d: Nazuna needs new blood for her cuddle-buddy business, and Ko is on the case; but he's not the only one wandering the night looking for someone.
A chat with a friend reveals Ko's lack of answers to some all-important questions.
The night feels distant; Ko isn't sure how to close that gap.

Ushio finds someone imprisoned in the basement of his family's shrine, and accidentally releases its aura, attracting thousands of monsters.
Tora begins following Ushio to school; Asako, Mayuko and the girls of the library club are attacked by a stone monster.
Ushio meets the daughter of a painter he likes and wants her to model for him.
Workers accidentally release a family of malicious demons bent on revenge.
A powerful exorcist seeks the monster that murdered his wife and child, and he's convinced that Tora is the yokai he seeks.
An ocean spirit asks Tora to help destroy a powerful serpent demon, and after he gets eaten, Tora asks Ushio for help.
Ushio presses his father for information about his mother; Ushio's father is given the order to kill Tora.

st: That Thing's Up In The Sky
d: Ushio and Tora's plane is attacked by a yokai that not even Tora may be able to defeat.
A mad yokai goes on a killing spree and his siblings beg Ushio to kill their brother.

st: The House Where the Child Dwells
d: A girl who cares for a captive yokai needs Ushio's help to free it.
Ushio sees a vision of Asako and Mayuko getting attacked by a mirror demon.

st: On the Road to the Tono Yokai Battle: Part 1
d: On the road to uncovering the truth about his mother, Ushio is attacked by a massive horde of demons, all hell-bent on ripping him apart.

st: On the Road to the Tono Yokai Battle: Part 2
d: Facing imminent death, Ushio prepares himself for the worst.
Ushio is intercepted by a young woman, one of four who've been trained to inherit the Beast Spear; faced with the truth, Ushio must decide whether to hand over the spear to its rightful owner.
Nagare comes to terms with Ushio as the wielder of the spear; tensions rise as Moritsuna, the most favored and most powerful successor of the Beast Spear, arrives.
Determined to battle the yokai possessing Moritsuna, Ushio plans to use the Beast Spear to enter a human's body.
As Ushio loses more of his soul, the spirit of the Kohamei Sect founder offers the only solution to stop his rampage.
Tora and the girls look to restore Ushio; Ushio's life, and everyone else's, falls on Asako's shoulders.
A monster inside the cave transports Ushio and Tora to ancient China; Ushio meets a young Jie Mei, the sister of the Beast Spear's creator.
Ushio, Jie Mei and Giryo are left shaken after the encounter with Hakumen no Mono; the true nature of the spear comes to light.
Ushio's homecoming is disturbed when the fourth successor, Kirio, appears; an avatar of Hakumen no Mono attacks.

st: Great Summoning - The Destruction of the Beast Spear
d: Kirio leads an attack on Ushio and takes the Beast Spear; the circumstances of Kirio's birth are revealed.
With no help available, Ushio must battle Kirio and his "mother" by himself.
Tora decides to haunt Mayuko for the day, but she is lured into a trap at a shopping center.
Scientists target Ushio and Tora, and Asako is caught in the crossfire.
Shigure and the JSDF close in on the lab as Ushio and Tora try to rescue Bal; Asako works with the H.A.M.M.R. scientists.
Everyone's memories are erased; Ushio is devastated when he discovers that no one knows who he is.
As Jie Mei's spirit appeals to the yokai to spare Mayuko's life, Ushio and Tora try to stop their plans.
Ushio's meeting with Hyou is interrupted by a pack of yokai.
After being betrayed by a close ally, Ushio is summoned by the surviving H.A.M.M.R. scientists.
Ushio and Tora rush to save his mother; Nagare and Tora face off; Ushio tries to get the JSDF to call off the attack.
Ushio prepares to meet his mother; the yokai of the East and West clash.

st: The Destruction of the Beast Spear
d: As the battle against Hakumen begins, Ushio loses his mind to the spear.
Ushio dreams of a child born on the night a star destroyed an ancient village and comes to realize Hakumen's origin.
As Tora squares off against Hakumen, Tora's memory is restored to the people who've forgotten him.
Humans and yokai unite behind Ushio to fight Hakumen; Saya opens the gates to the underworld for help; Hyou faces Guren in a fight to the death.
Mayuko tries to revive a wounded Tora.
The humans join the fight at sea; Ushio and Tora find themselves at the mercy of Hakumen's most dangerous form.

st: The Destiny of Ushio and Tora
d: Hakumen, driven mad with hatred, hunts down the spear; Ushio and Tora make an impossible choice.
